name: Vercel AI Gateway
description: Routes model calls from any app or coding agent across providers with one API key, adding fallbacks, request logs, spend budgets, and BYOK, via the AI SDK or OpenAI-compatible APIs.

skills.name: Provider Failover
skills.description: Routes a model across healthy providers with ordered provider and model fallbacks.

skills.name: Request Logging
skills.description: Records each request's model, provider attempts, latency, token usage, status, and cost.

skills.name: Spending Controls
skills.description: Sets budgets for a team, project, API key, or team member and rejects new requests once a budget is exceeded.

skills.name: Bring Your Own Key
skills.description: Uses your own provider accounts and credentials through the gateway with no markup on token prices.

skills.name: Modalities
skills.description: Serves text, image, and video generation, speech, transcription, realtime, embeddings, and reranking models.
